scope: CPU-only structural diagnostic, 320 query rows; no query/GPU/E2E timing, no pivot/summary/direction variants
partition_rule: P2 widest local span of rounded FP64 pivot norms; lowest dimension ties; lexsort(norm, immutable occurrence ID); split floor(n/2), left then right; independently restart each target; stop len<=target; never flatten/rechunk
anchor: 256 permutation, starts and all 64 GLOBAL4 query counts must match qualified S1/P2 exactly

gates.GO: One SAME target in128/64/32, zero false prune, BOTH mean surviving-object fraction<=.50 and EACH reduction vs256>=.20, metadata ratio<=8
gates.STRONG: Inherit GO; both means<=.35 and metadata ratio<=4
gates.CONDITIONAL_SUPPORTED: No GO/no NO; one SAME target in128/64/32 with BOTH .50<mean<=.60 and EACH gain>=.15
gates.NO_GO: No GO; target32 has BOTH means>.60 OR BOTH gains<.10
gates.UNCOVERED: CONDITIONAL_GRANULARITY reason uncovered_interval; not positive; no update admission
gates.selection: Positive configurations ranked coarsest-first (lowest metadata); at most first two same targets for both snapshots; no per-snapshot winner selection
gates.correctness: Any false prune/input/source/anchor mismatch aborts before decision; missing evidence is not NO-GO
gates.next_phase: This campaign launches no CUDA. Update only after positive static gate and independent verification; no automatic tile16/8, more pivots, summaries or long run

updates.admission: Only GO or specified positive conditional; uncovered interval is not admitted
updates.initialization: Independent P2 capacity-aware balanced initializer with active=floor(15*target/16), preserving prior 6.25% nominal slack; actual occupancy reported and layout separately reevaluated
updates.ownership: Fine tiles for this bounded recheck; global nearest signature centroid placement (lowest ID ties), lowest hole, local first-pivot split at target+1; no new coarse/fine system here
updates.gate: changed_tiles/initial_tiles<=.05; retain movement, splits, metadata refreshes; no timing claim; global centroid scans are not local computation

novelty_gate.status: Falsification diagnostic, not a novelty claim. Smaller work units and filter/refine tradeoffs are established.
novelty_gate.next: If structurally positive, separate prior-art kill test before claiming a GPU ownership/execution co-design contribution
